stories.title: Final Hong Kong team named for ACC Trophy Elite 2010 in Kuwait
stories.subTitle: ACC Trophy Elite 2010
stories.summary: The Hong Kong Selections have announced the final 14-man squad for the upcoming ACC Trophy Elite 2010 tournament to be played in Kuwait from 31 March to 9 April 2010.

stories.title: Disappointing end to Hong Kong's Under-19 campaign
stories.subTitle: ACC Under-19 Elite Cup
stories.summary: Hong Kong's campaign at the ACC Under-19 Elite Cup 2007 came to a disappointing end today as they were soundly beaten by Oman at the Club Aman ground in the play-off match for 7th and 8th places.
